audit_bound: Each 16-candidate P/PG pool repeats B and K3 carry across generations; union <=26 per state plus3 normal prefix designs and two parents =>57. Every actual attempt counted, not waived as a duplicate.
failure_budget: All subsequent failed/retry attempts consume spare budget; conditional extra/pilot omitted if insufficient. No development/test result changes candidate budget, metric, task, physics, safety or action authority.
extra_test_rule: If pilot not promoted and >=16 physical attempts plus >=1 hour before dispatch cutoff, use four untouched groups with frozen independent weights, new search seeds and legal prefixes; no new fitting. Never use those outcomes to restart development or retroactively promote pilot.
